evidence: The HfCl4 chemisorption reaction was performed in an ALCVD PULSAR 2000 reactor, attached to the Polygon platform. c HfCl4 was heated to approximately 185°C to achieve sufficient vapor pressure for the HfCl4 pulses. Pulse lengths of 0.1 s were applied to saturate the surface. The HfCl4 reaction was investigated at a reactor temperature of 300°C.
